name: UBIS JDBC Export
description: Reads DB2, Oracle, or Vertica by JDBC and writes to GCS or BigQuery.

parameters.name: db_type
parameters.label: Database Type
parameters.helpText: Source database type: db2, oracle, or vertica.

parameters.name: connection_url
parameters.label: JDBC Connection URL
parameters.helpText: JDBC connection URL for the source database.

parameters.name: password_secret
parameters.label: Secret Manager Password Resource
parameters.helpText: Secret Manager resource name containing the database password.

parameters.name: driver_jars
parameters.label: JDBC Driver JAR
parameters.helpText: GCS URI of the JDBC driver JAR.

parameters.name: query_uri
parameters.label: Rendered SQL GCS URI
parameters.helpText: GCS URI of the business-date rendered SQL file.

parameters.name: output_path
parameters.label: GCS Output Prefix
parameters.helpText: GCS output prefix. Required when destination_type is gcs.

parameters.name: output_format
parameters.label: GCS Output Format
parameters.helpText: GCS output format: json, csv, or parquet.

parameters.name: parquet_schema
parameters.label: Parquet Schema JSON
parameters.helpText: JSON schema used for Parquet output. Required when output_format is parquet.

parameters.name: output_table
parameters.label: BigQuery Output Table
parameters.helpText: BigQuery table in project:dataset.table form. Required for BigQuery output.

parameters.name: bq_schema
parameters.label: BigQuery Schema JSON
parameters.helpText: BigQuery schema JSON. Required for BigQuery output.

parameters.name: write_disposition
parameters.label: BigQuery Write Disposition
parameters.helpText: BigQuery write disposition, for example WRITE_APPEND.

parameters.name: create_disposition
parameters.label: BigQuery Create Disposition
parameters.helpText: BigQuery create disposition, for example CREATE_IF_NEEDED.
